clauses.text: Prevent the ops agent from mutating workloads outside the agents namespace
clauses.note: Authorization expressed as admission; the durable fix is scoping the agent's RBAC. Admission is the backstop.

clauses.text: Require a ticket reference on any change the agent makes
clauses.note: Starts at Warn: the agent's tool server cannot add the annotation until it is updated.

clauses.text: Do not stop the agent from reading
clauses.note: Admission never sees reads. Nothing to generate; RBAC keeps get/list untouched.
